messages:
isabel: Quick creative ask for next-week launch push — need a compact asset bundle by Tue 3pm PT: (1) benchmark hero (1200x600) with two headline slots and an optional small schematic panel, (2) gated webinar modal (480x320) with hidden routing fields, (3) animated social vertical (9:16, ~15s) + a 1:1 carousel slide for paid socials. Keep strictly on-brand and accessible. cc @rachel @santiago

rachel: Got it. Can you paste the primary + alt headlines and the figma link? Also confirm localization (JP?) and whether we need FR.

isabel: Primary: "Predictable LLM inference for production." Alt: "Lower unit cost, consistent latency." Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch-4959-mini-suite
Localization: JP yes (headline + modal labels). FR not required for this push.

santiago: Design note: prefer a small schematic (boxes + arrows) to explain the serving path (request → prefix cache → batch router → GPU pool → response). Use simple flat icons, no chip/vendor names. Schematic should be optional on the hero (toggleable layer).

mira: Legal quick note: avoid absolute % claims or comparative superlatives. Use words like "lower" or "reduced" rather than "X% faster". I'll review copy after drafts.

rachel: Timeline: mock frames Fri EOD, copy/legal review Mon, localization Tue morning, final assets Tue 3pm. Is that ok?

isabel: Yes. Priority order: hero > modal > social clip. Also need an export-ready alt-high-contrast CTA variant and an alt text file for all assets.

santiago: For the webinar modal, we need hidden fields for inbound routing: utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_variant, webinar_id, route_tier. Can design include a tiny help text: "We'll capture submission details to help route your request"?

isabel: Yes please. Webinar param: ?webinar_id=2026-08-10. route_tier values will be set by marketing ops.

rachel: Analytics asked for distinct UTMs per headline variant. Example:```
utm_campaign=prod_launch_aug2026
utm_source=social
utm_variant=latency_first
```and for the other: utm_variant=cost_first. Also add utm_content=creative_{format}.

santiago: GIF direction: 9:16 vertical, subtle sparkline animate into view, CTA pulse, ease-in loop, target export mp4 + gif fallback (<2MB if possible). Keep motion minimal for accessibility. Add a short motion description file.

mira: Accessibility: CTA must meet 4.5:1 contrast against hero backgrounds. If we use imagery, apply a 24% dark overlay. Provide exports with and without overlay so dev can pick. Also include alt text and concise motion description for animated clip.

isabel: Brand tokens: CTA #FF3B30, body Inter, CTA weight 600. Please include swatches in figma and an alt-high-contrast CTA token.

figmabot: Frame created: launch_mini_hero_4959 (1200x600), webinar_modal_compact_4959 (480x320), social_clip_vertical_4959 (1080x1920), carousel_1x1_4959 (1080x1080 x3). Link: https://figma.com/frame/4959-frames-abc

santiago: Uploading hero + modal drafts now. I'll keep headline text in separate layers for easy swaps and build the schematic as an optional group.

rachel: I'll drop a copy pass in the figma file and ping legal. Mira, tagging you for review once drafts are uploaded.

mira: Will review Monday AM. Reminder: no chip/vendor names and avoid unverified performance claims.

isabel: Final handoff checklist for engineering: figma frames, export PNG/JPG/MP4/GIF, SVG for schematic, alt-text CSV, and a small CSV with the final utm strings for each variant. Also add a note in the figma with the exact modal hidden field names.

santiago: Noted — I'll attach export checklist and a CSV in the figma drive folder. Comment thread link: https://figma.com/comments/4959-creative-ops

isabel: Thanks all — will review first drafts when they drop. Timeline recap one last time: drafts Fri EOD, legal/copy Mon, JP localization Tue morning, final assets Tue 3pm PT.

rachel: :thumbsup: ping here when uploads are ready for review.

figmabot: Checklist updated and token dropped: CTA color = #FF3B30; alt-high-contrast token added.
